title: Temporal trends in myocardial infarction morbidity and coronary mortality in the Augsburg population over 25 years of age based on the Augsburg myocardial infarction register.
summary: In 1984, the Helmholtz Zentrum München established a population-based myocardial infarction  registry for residents of the city of Augsburg and the districts of Augsburg and Aichach-Friedberg to participate in the WHO-MONICA project. The main question was and is to investigate the connection between potential risk factors for cardiovascular diseases and the frequency of the occurrence and course of heart attacks.

interventions.name:
Hospitalized cases of acute myocardial infarction:
Identification of hospitalized cases of acute myocardial infarction in all hospitals of the study region; contacting of the patients (information, declaration of consent, interview on the event); elaboration of the patients’ medical files.

Coron

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Diagnosis of a myocardial infarction event (ICD10: I21) or of a layered ischaemia of the myocardium (ICD10: I25) OR death suspected of being due to coronary heart desease

Patient age: 25 years and older

Main residence in the study region
Exclusion criteria:
Main residence outside of the study region.
